description: Consolidation merge decisions for the retrieval vs text-matching adapter bake-off. paraphrase = the same fact stated differently and SHOULD merge. contradiction = the same subject and predicate with an incompatible value; these answer the same question, so a retrieval-trained geometry is expected to place them close, and merging them would silently destroy a belief revision. unrelated = an easy negative that any adapter should reject.
